title: Gaggenau — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Gaggenau.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Luxury tier. Gaggenau is the ultra-luxury brand from BSH Group — the same parent company as Bosch and Thermador. Founded in 1683 as a nail factory in the Black Forest village of Gaggenau, Germany, it is the oldest appliance brand in the world. Gaggenau products are handcrafted and positioned as functional art. The Vario cooling system, combi-steam ovens, and 400 Series Vario cooking modules define the pinnacle of kitchen design.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Ultra-luxury builds, architect-specified projects, customers for whom price is irrelevant and design is everything.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Gaggenau:

• Oldest appliance brand in the world — founded 1683, over 340 years of German craftsmanship

• Vario 400 Series cooking modules — mix and match cooktops, grills, fryers, steamers

• Combi-steam oven does conventional, steam, and combination — one appliance replaces three

• Fully integrated panel-ready across the line — everything disappears behind cabinetry

• The brand architects specify when budget has no ceiling
